name: _addmm_activation_out
description: ATen schema: aten::_addmm_activation.out(Tensor self, Tensor mat1, Tensor mat2, *, Scalar beta=1, Scalar alpha=1, bool use_gelu=False, Tensor(a!) out) -> Tensor(a!). Writes the activated matrix product into out and returns that tensor. Pinned master accuracy cases compare numerical output across their matrix shapes, floating dtypes, scalar alpha/beta values and use_gelu settings. The selected tests do not separately establish return identity, resizing, noncontiguous output layout, or invalid dtype rejection. Benchmark retains the original input layout cases.
